hook: Deloitte helped Roman Abramovich hide assets by falsifying 1,000 corporate documents.

sections.voiceover: Deloitte helped Roman Abramovich hide assets by falsifying 1,000 corporate documents.
Staff in Cyprus used fake timestamps to rewrite historical records behind closed doors. Where did $672 million in assets go?
But the spin-off firm Meritservus also actively assisted in this massive, multi-million dollar cover-up.
Abramovich successfully obscured his massive fortune through this systematic manipulation of 1,000 corporate documents.
Corporate audits were weaponized to protect 672 million dollars in assets.
